about_the_game:
Visit the world of Shiz University in this Funko Fusion character pack! Return to Universal Pictures’ Wicked and relive the university years of Elphaba, Glinda and Prince Fiyero and play as their Shiz variants. This pack includes:

  • Elphaba (Shiz)

  • Glinda (Shiz)

  • Prince Fiyero

 

Play as their Shiz-era variants and experience their early days like never before!
